meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能体自动部署应用到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让 agent 帮你把 Web 应用一键部署到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let agents deploy web apps to Vercel automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want agents to deploy web apps to Vercel with one click

howto.what: 安装 Vercel CLI 并配置 OneCLI 凭据注入，使 NanoClaw 智能体能够部署 Web 应用到 Vercel。
howto.when: 当用户要求智能体将 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 帮我部署这个项目到 Vercel。
say.note: 智能体会自动安装 CLI 并配置凭据。

say.text: 检查我的 Vercel 部署状态。
say.note: 智能体使用 Vercel CLI 列出部署。

howto.what_en: Installs Vercel CLI and configures OneCLI credential injection, enabling NanoClaw agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks the agent to deploy a web application to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel for me.
say_en.note: Agent will install CLI and configure credentials automatically.
